aboutPage.title: Ecommerce made simpler by design.
aboutPage.lead: We help merchants launch professional online stores without the cost and risk of building software from scratch.
aboutPage.label: ABOUT SNAKER
aboutPage.problemText1: Retail entrepreneurs often have to choose between expensive custom development and bloated platforms that make simple store management feel complicated.
aboutPage.problemText2: Most businesses need a clean catalog, reliable order flow, and a practical path to payments. They should not have to become software maintainers.
aboutPage.architectureText1: Snaker keeps hosting, storefront performance, setup flow, and operational details in one focused platform so merchants can spend more time on products and customers.
aboutPage.architectureText2: Start with WhatsApp ordering on the Free plan, then move toward custom domain, checkout, and Business support when the operation is ready.
